Hi Alex —

Great to speak earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive and dedicated capacity sizing session: 

TL;DR
- We’ll run a short product demo (45m) focusing on the integration points you mentioned, followed immediately by a dedicated capacity sizing session (60m) to map throughput + latency to pool options.
- Please confirm which time slot works and share the preliminary traffic profile (RPS, tokens/request, burst patterns).

Recap of what you shared (summarized):
- Primary use case: real-time chat summarization and snippet generation for Skybound search UX.
- Expected steady-state: ~150 req/s; burst up to ~400 req/s during peak indexing windows.
- Typical context sizes: 600–1,200 tokens; occasional 2k token requests.
- Security: prefer Private deployment (VPC) with customer-managed KMS.

What we need from you before the sizing call: 
- Confirm a preferred time slot below.
- Attach (or paste) a short load profile or CI logs if available (I attached a blank intake sheet you can fill).
- Any hard p95 latency SLAs you need for user-facing calls.

Proposed slots (PST) — pick one, or propose alternatives:
- Tues Nov 10 — 10:00–11:45 (demo + sizing, 105 minutes)
- Wed Nov 11 — 13:00–14:45 (demo + sizing, 105 minutes)
- Thu Nov 12 — 09:00–10:45 (demo + sizing, 105 minutes)

If you’d prefer to split into two shorter sessions (45m demo + 60m sizing on separate days), say the word and we’ll split.

Attachments: skybound-load-intake.xlsx (intake template)

Next steps on our side: I’ll loop Ben (solutions) and Karthik (inference) to prep pool sizing options and a short pre-read on model variants and quantization tradeoffs.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a slot.

Best,

Thanks for the clear notes and the intake template. Wed Nov 11 13:00–14:45 PST works for our team — please book it.

A couple of quick clarifications that will help your sizing prep:
- Confirmed avg traffic: ~150 req/s steady, expected spikes up to ~400 req/s for 2–3 minutes during reindex windows (happens ~4x/day).
- Token profile: median ~800 tokens, 95th ~2,000 tokens.
- p95 latency target for interactive UX: <=300ms (user-facing snippet generation).
